candidates.title: UUPM/Multi-Theme and reusable design/configuration primitives
candidates.rationale: Visual styling tokens and design system primitives are presentation-only and can be safely re-themed for CubeFarm walls.
candidates.portability_notes: Port UUPM design tokens and theme switching primitives without duplicating underlying business domain logic.

candidates.title: Reusable dashboard/projection patterns suitable for the Living Office
candidates.rationale: Dashboard grid, card layouts, and projection panels provide spatial layout structures without owning core domain state.
candidates.portability_notes: Reusable UI layout structures projected in Living Office.

candidates.title: Capability/tool surfaces only as consumers of #333
candidates.rationale: Surfaces consume registered capabilities via Agent OS capability fabric (#333); never duplicate Business executors.

candidates.title: Evidence/runtime-status widgets rendering Agent/Life/Business state
candidates.rationale: Widgets consume typed adapters from Agent, Life, and Business OS to project status on CubeFarm walls.
candidates.portability_notes: Renders state from typed adapters; strictly read-only or capability-driven.

candidates.title: Reusable auth/session UX primitives
candidates.rationale: Must not duplicate #417 credential authority or token treasury. Quarantined from independent execution in CubeFarm.
candidates.portability_notes: Keep auth/session UX strictly quarantined to enforce #417 single source of truth.
